concerns.text: Plan's Complexity Tracking sanctions two analyses — 'Permutation Test' (to handle non-normal error distributions) and 'VIF Analysis' (to quantify collinearity between bulk and local features) — but no task in tasks.md implements either. No task computes a permutation test on the baseline-vs-augmented MAE delta, and no task computes VIF. Add tasks (e.g., in Phase 4) covering both, or the plan's stated statistical-validity strategy is unimplemented.

concerns.location: tasks.md vs plan.md:Project Structure / constitution Principle III
concerns.text: Plan's structure includes 'state/projects/PROJ-116-.../artifact_hashes.yaml' and the constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed with checksums recorded in the artifact_hashes map. No task computes or records checksums of raw/processed data files (T011 only saves the CSV). Add a checksumming task after data download and feature-engineering outputs.

FR-006 and the Assumptions state that if the 4-hour / 7 GB limits are exceeded 'the system must log an error and terminate gracefully'. T032 only benchmarks and writes performance_metrics.json; no task implements enforcement/abort-on-exceedance behavior in the pipeline. Add a task (e.g., extend config.py or a wrapper) implementing the graceful-termination requirement.

T028 says variance_fp/variance_fn are 'standard deviation across thresholds' computed per-threshold row — a per-row value cannot be a cross-threshold statistic; the summary (T029) presumably aggregates. This is a minor description ambiguity, not a coverage gap; clarify that per-threshold rows carry the metrics and T029 computes the cross-threshold variance.
